description: Show active shopping lists and their items

system_context.engine_import: from engine.base import SkillBase, SkillRequest, SkillResponse

context.table_schema:
Table: shopping_lists (id uuid PK, name varchar(200), status varchar(20) default 'active', is_active boolean default true, created_at timestamptz)
Table: shopping_list_items (id uuid PK, list_id uuid FK, item_id uuid FK, quantity numeric, priority varchar(20) default 'normal', notes text, completed boolean default false)
Table: shopping_items (id uuid PK, name varchar(200), department varchar(100), default_unit varchar(50), usual_price numeric, is_active boolean)

JOIN path: shopping_lists -> shopping_list_items -> shopping_items
All IDs are uuid type. Cast to str when returning.

mandatory_patterns.connection_cleanup: try/except/finally. Close cursor and connection in finally.
mandatory_patterns.skillresponse_signature: SkillResponse ONLY accepts: skill_name (str), data (dict), summary (str), confidence (float), sources (list), error (str|None). NEVER use success/message/text/ok/result.
mandatory_patterns.fetchone_dict: With RealDictCursor, fetchone() returns a dict. Use row['column_name'] not row[0].

build_plan.instruction: Write file skeleton. Imports: os, logging, psycopg2, RealDictCursor, dotenv, engine.base. _get_conn() EXACTLY as mandatory_patterns. Class QueryShoppingListsSkill with name='query_shopping_lists', triggers=['shopping', 'shopping list', 'groceries', 'grocery list', 'what do I need to buy', 'need to get', 'shopping items'], cache_ttl=300. Methods: execute, _query_lists, _query_items, _format_results, _build_summary. All have 'pass'. ASCII only.

Implement _query_lists() and _query_items(). _query_lists: SELECT id, name, status, created_at FROM shopping_lists WHERE is_active = true ORDER BY created_at DESC. _query_items(list_id): SELECT sli.id, si.name as item_name, si.department, sli.quantity, sli.priority, sli.completed, sli.notes FROM shopping_list_items sli JOIN shopping_items si ON si.id = sli.item_id WHERE sli.list_id = %s ORDER BY sli.completed, si.department, si.name. Both use _get_conn() with try/finally close. Cast uuid ids to str().

Implement _format_results() and _build_summary(). Format: for each list, dict with id (str), name, status, items (list of dicts: item_name, department, quantity, priority, completed). Summary: 'N active shopping list(s). LIST_NAME: X items (Y remaining).' Show uncompleted items for top list.

Implement execute(). Query lists. For each list, query its items. Format and summarize. If no lists: 'No active shopping lists.' Return SkillResponse(skill_name=self.name, data={'lists': formatted, 'count': len}, summary=summary, confidence=0.95, sources=['mythos.shopping_lists', 'mythos.shopping_items']). try/except/finally.
Review. _get_conn uses POSTGRES_HOST. UUIDs cast to str. Connections close. SkillResponse valid kwargs only. Summary never empty. ASCII only. Production-ready.

test_cases.message: what is on my shopping list
do I need to buy anything
